source_title: BFSI Summit 2026: Top experts from the finance world to share insights - Business Standard
source_excerpt: The Business Standard BFSI Insight Summit, India’s premier financial industry event, returns for a three-day session at Mumbai’s Jio World Convention Centre starting October 26. State Bank of India Chairman C S Setty will inaugurate the summit and participate in a fireside chat, with Shaktikanta Das, principal secretary 2 to the Prime Minister, attending as chief guest. A prominent regulatory and policy line-up — including Sebi Chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey, Irdai Chairman Ajay Seth, PFRDA Chairperson S Ramann and RBI Deputy Governor Poonam Gupta — will join corporate titans to debate pressing structural issues, ranging from interest rate cycles and bond market volatility to AI integration, cyber resilience, and crypto regulation. Sessions will span public and private banking, fintech innovations, mutual funds, insurance, microfinance, and private equity. High-profile panel discussions featuring market stalwarts, prominent economists, and leading treasury heads will tackle critical questions around deposit mobilisation, credit expansion, and GIFT City's growing role as a global financial hub. Additionally, a parallel Arena track featuring market commentators like Ankur Warikoo, Devina Mehra, Rachana Ranade and Vijay Kedia will deliver practical, actionable insights curated for retail investors navigating market swings. The initiative bridges the gap between investors seeking clarity and the experts qualified to deliver it—catering to absolute beginners and seasoned wealth-builders alike.
